title: Safer gameplay and clearer fact sources
body:
- Hardened guest progress, reloads, login synchronization, and question and guess limits across game modes.
- Added fact-source information and improved keyboard navigation, map controls, and modal accessibility.
- Standardized daily puzzle dates on UTC and tightened application configuration and deployment checks.
- Added isolated desktop and mobile gameplay checks while preserving the ocean and regional answer fixes from 1.23.4.

Your saved game progress, streaks, and daily question and guess limits are unchanged.
